theorem.barrier: For a negative-definite weak-incidence packet, a_B>=-1/2 and a_R,a_E>=0.
theorem.singularity_scope: For a normal Q-Gorenstein contraction whose full exceptional divisor is the SNC packet, all log discrepancies are >=1/2; under the strict convention this is epsilon-klt for every 0<epsilon<1/2, not necessarily 1/2-klt.
theorem.tail_obstruction: Finite-nef-vertex discrepancy bounds alone cannot bound rank: successive point blowups of P2 give arbitrary R...R-E tails; no global full-nef Coxeter property is asserted.
